alert_news.title: IIT Gandhinagar's PG Diploma in AI-ML & Agentic AI Engineering to Begin New Cohort in September 2026
bullets: India’s first postgraduate AI program delivered entirely on an IIT campus, offered by IIT Gandhinagar as a residential PG Diploma in AI‑ML & Agentic AI Engineering.
The program, starting September 2026, is fully residential on the 400‑acre campus and differs from other IIT AI programmes that are online or weekend‑format.

alert_news.title: Mumbai to host the first edition of SpaceFest, celebrating space and science
bullets: India’s first large‑scale event dedicated to space, science, innovation and space‑inspired pop culture – SpaceFest – to be held in Mumbai.
The inaugural edition is scheduled for 2026 and aims to combine knowledge dissemination with entertainment, featuring dedicated zones for sci‑fi and gaming.

alert_news.title: India's First Assembly Line for H125 Light Utility Helicopter
bullets: India’s first assembly line for the H125 Light Utility Helicopter, inaugurated in Vemagal, Karnataka, by Tata Advanced Systems in partnership with Airbus
The facility will produce H125 helicopters for domestic use and export, marking the first Indian-built H125 capable of high-altitude operations

alert_news.title: Meet 'Samarthak': India's First Indigenously Built Multi-Purpose Naval Support Vessel
bullets: India’s first indigenously built multi‑purpose naval support vessel ‘Samarthak’ constructed by L&T at Kattupalli Shipyard, Chennai
Displacement 3,750 tonnes, length 107 m, beam 18.6 m, speed 15 knots, operational range 4,500 nautical miles, 75 % local content

alert_news.title: Amaravati: India's 1st dedicated university for quantum tech, AI
bullets: India’s first dedicated university for quantum computing and artificial intelligence, established in Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh, by NIELIT under the Ministry of Electronics & IT
8.5‑acre campus funded at Rs 730 crore, designed to train 8,250 learners over five years
